english.title: Cause / incite sexual activity with a mentally disordered female - penetration - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally caused or incited a

(A)_[woman]_
(B)_[girl under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..),]_

who was unable to refuse because of or for a reason related to a mental disorder, when you knew or could reasonably be expected to have known that she had such a disorder and that because of it, or for a reason related to it, she was likely to be unable to refuse, to engage in a sexual activity involving the penetration of

(C)_[her anus]_
(D)_[her vagina]_
(E)_[her mouth with a person's penis]_
(F)_[a person's anus with a part of her body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE BODY..)]_
(G)_[a person's vagina with a part of her body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE BODY..)]_
(H)_[a person's anus by her with a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..)]_
(I)_[a person's vagina by her with a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..)]_
(J)_[**(..WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE ACTIVITIES ARE INVOLVED PLEASE SPECIFY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(1) and (3) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 72 of, and Schedule 2 to, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by UK nationals / residents.
(ii) A person convicted of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act. (Sch 3 paragraph 27).
